UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly avoid generic AI slop: no standard purple/blue tech gradients (#7351B7 is forbidden). Use deep Krishna midnight navy (#060D24, #030712) with radiant gold (#D4AF37, #F59E0B) and peacock teal/cyan (#0D9488, #06B6D4).
Do not use generic centered layout. Keep asymmetric grids, strong left-aligned editorial typography, and high visual hierarchy.
Do not use Inter or plain Arial for headers. Use Cinzel or Playfair Display with tracking-tight for royal Vedic authority.
Ensure ALL interactive items (buttons, inputs, tabs, demo toggles) have data-testid attributes matching kebap-case convention.
All navigation and surface headers must have solid or heavy frosted glass backgrounds (never 100% transparent).
The punchline MUST prominently feature: 'Driven By Purpose. Powered by Intelligence'.

OTT streaming is the star offering: include an interactive OTT stream simulator or feature console so users immediately understand GovindasTech builds enterprise-grade live/VOD/FAST streaming products.
Include modern CRM & feedback features: real-time telemetry, sentiment analysis, viewer ticket escalation, and interactive feedback rating.
